turns.text: —AND THAT'S WHEN I BIT IT. mid-air. rotor still spinning. worth it.

for context: they replaced my apartment with a HOLOGRAPHIC parking lot. not even a real one. you can walk through it. i tried. i live there now, technically, if 'living' means phasing through fake asphalt at 2am

used to operate the KILLDOZER myself. six years. tore down other cats' walls for a paycheck and a pat on the head. never thought the arm would swing back around to my own block but here we are, sleeping in vent 14-B like it's a promotion

they call me a domestic extremist for BITING SURVEILLANCE HARDWARE. no. i call it pest control. the drone was in MY airspace. my vent. my rent-free crawlspace kingdom. this is not a metaphor, i live in the walls now

my mother still calls me HANDSOME through the vent grate every sunday like nothing happened. KNIFEBOY thinks that's soft. KNIFEBOY sleeps in a loading dock, i sleep in structural infrastructure, we are not the same
third drone this week. they keep sending bigger ones like escalation is gonna teach me a lesson. buddy. i took down BUILDINGS for a living. you're a flying toaster with a camera
